uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: A team of one should buy a scaled-down version of team tooling.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: A solo rep doesn't need a smaller Gong — they need the parts of conversation intelligence that serve the seller, without the reporting layer built for a manager who doesn't exist.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Team platforms price and design for oversight; a team of one has nobody to oversee.
